question: A typist takes 40 minutes to type 2 pages. How many pages will he type in 60 minutes?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

2 pages in 40 min ⇒ 1 page in 20 min

So in 60 min ⇒ 60 ÷ 20 = 3 pages

**∴ Answer = 3 pages**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time = 40 minutes, Pages = 2

Required time = 60 minutes

**Formula used:**

Work ∝ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Pages per minute = 2 ÷ 40

⇒ = 1/20 page per minute

⇒ Pages in 60 minutes = 60 × 1/20

⇒ = 3 pages

**∴ The correct answer is 3 pages.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unitary Method

Find value of 1 unit first, then multiply accordingly.

Direct Proportion

More time ⇒ more work, hence directly proportional.

Rate Concept

Rate = Work ÷ Time

Efficiency

Efficiency = Work done per unit time.
